en: Dependent on a state without sustained thought (*avitakka*), a state without sustained thought arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state without sustained thought, a state without sustained thought arises by way of root condition ... three.

Dependent on a state both with initial thought and without sustained thought (*savitakka-savicāra* and *avitakka-avicāra*), a state without sustained thought arises by way of root condition ... three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; ... [and so on] ... in the case of the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are six; ... [and so on] ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are nine.
